name: cursor-edge-glow-button
title: Cursor Edge Glow Button
description: 移植自 MicroKit，MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Henrique Barone。 https://github.com/henriquegpb/microkit/blob/fd993e8/registry/microkit/cursor-edge-glow-button.tsx 边缘光跟着指针做弹簧滑动。聚焦时停在中间。触屏按下也会把光带到落点。空闲时不申请动画帧。减弱动效停在终态。离开视口时连续动画暂停，回到视口再继续。
